title: Resize squares on a layer turned in 3D take the press where they are drawn
goal: When a layer is swung or tipped in 3D, its eight resize squares and corner dots are drawn on the turned card, but pressing on them does nothing (the press still looks for them where the flat layer would be). A person sees handles that do not respond. Either make them resize the turned card from where they are drawn, or stop drawing handles that cannot be taken.
notes: Found by every-handle-lights-on-hover-walk while building hover feedback (2026-10-12). Reproduction: a rectangle drawn on a blank 1120x760 picture, picked, swung with the green arc by 67pt (Rotation Y 40), then the walk step {"do":"hoverHandles","name":"2-turned","space":true} on all handles. Command: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/every-handle-lights-on-hover-walk.json (with the 2-turned step not filtered). Output: FAILED: the pointer rested on the resize-topLeft handle at view (317, 309) and nothing lit up; the canvas says a press there would be "none". Cause (from code): CanvasDisplay draws frame handles through the layer drawnMap homography (chromePoint with spaceMap), while CanvasPointer.cue and the mouseDown resize branch hit test in CanvasPointer.handleSpacePoint, which only undoes the flat LayerTransform, not the 3D turn. The resize drag itself would also have to follow the plane, so this is more than a hit-test fix.
acceptance: On a layer swung 40 degrees on Y, resting the pointer on each drawn resize square lights it and shows the resize arrows, and a drag from it resizes the layer
Or, if resizing a turned card is decided against, no resize square or corner dot is drawn on a layer seen in space
The walk every-handle-lights-on-hover-walk checks the turned card with all its handles (drop its only: rotate filter)
